query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `pc_bank_applications` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `organizationId` int NOT NULL,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `status` enum('draft', 'submitted', 'under_review', 'approved', 'rejected', 'action_required') DEFAULT 'draft' NOT NULL,
  `currentStep` int DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  `completionPercent` int DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  `fillFasterSubmissionId` varchar(255),
  `fillFasterApplicationUrl` varchar(500),
  `lastSyncedAt` timestamp NULL,
  `legalBusinessName` varchar(255),
  `dbaName` varchar(255),
  `businessEmail` varchar(255),
  `businessPhone` varchar(50),
  `website` varchar(500),
  `dateBusinessStarted` varchar(50),
  `businessAddress` varchar(500),
  `businessCity` varchar(100),
  `businessState` varchar(50),
  `businessZip` varchar(20),
  `businessCountry` varchar(100) DEFAULT 'USA',
  `ein` varchar(50),
  `businessType` varchar(100),
  `stateOfIncorporation` varchar(100),
  `ownerFirstName` varchar(100),
  `ownerLastName` varchar(100),
  `ownerTitle` varchar(100),
  `ownerSSN` varchar(50),
  `ownerDOB` varchar(50),
  `ownerAddress` varchar(500),
  `ownerCity` varchar(100),
  `ownerState` varchar(50),
  `ownerZip` varchar(20),
  `ownerPhone` varchar(50),
  `ownerEmail` varchar(255),
  `ownerOwnershipPercent` varchar(10),
  `bankName` varchar(255),
  `bankAccountNumber` varchar(100),
  `bankRoutingNumber` varchar(50),
  `averageMonthlyVolume` varchar(50),
  `averageTicketSize` varchar(50),
  `highestTicketSize` varchar(50),
  `uploadedDocuments` json,
  `agreeToTerms` int DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  `authorizedSignature` varchar(255),
  `signatureDate` varchar(50),
  `ipAddress` varchar(100),
  `submittedAt` timestamp NULL,
  `approvedAt` timestamp NULL,
  `rejectedAt` timestamp NULL,
  `rejectionReason` text,
  `actionRequiredNotes` text,
  `internalNotes` text,
  `createdAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  `updatedAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX `idx_org_status` (`organizationId`, `status`),
  INDEX `idx_fillfaster_id` (`fillFasterSubmissionId`)
);
